    state: &AppState,
    headers: &HeaderMap,
    body: Value,
) -> Response {
    let routing_body = body.clone();
    forward(
        state,
        headers,
        body,
        &routing_body,
        Surface::OpenAIChat,
        ShapeIn::Chat,
        None,
    )
    .await
}
